data.name: Mehboob
data.gender_notes: Mehboob is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mehboob is an Arabic name for boys that means 'beloved', 'loved one', and 'lover'. The name Mehboob carries the meaning “Beloved, Lover” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mehboob usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved, lover and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Mehboob is one of the 99 names of Allah, meaning 'the beloved'.
data.etymology: Mehboob belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beloved, Lover.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mehboob total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
